__doc__: OP WP #312 CW Energy TOPCon structured_specs template. Values are NULL by design: fill from the manufacturer datasheet before running. Keys are validated against forge/spec_schemas solar_panels. Remove keys you have no value for; null-valued keys are skipped by the storefront frontend.
__match_by_note__: Each panel key below must match an existing product slug (default), or run with --match-by part_number and use MPNs. The cw-energy-... keys are PLACEHOLDERS — replace with the real slugs/MPNs.
